```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ape)
library(MASS)
library(glmmTMB)
library(dplyr)   
library(DHARMa)
source('../R/getData_current.R')
source('../R/MeanAbund.R')
source('../R/U_current.R')
source('../R/fit_model_current2.R')
source('../R/get_num.eig.R')
load('../data/Para_PCV.RData')

# Model refitting function
refit <- function(seed) {
  set.seed(seed)

  update(
    Model$fit,
    family = stats::binomial(link = "logit"),
    data = Model$fit$frame,
    control = glmmTMBControl(
      start_method = list(method = "res", jitter.sd = 0.2),
      optCtrl = list(iter.max = 1000, eval.max = 1000)
    )
  )
}
```

# 1 Parameters
```{r}
#seedID <- params$seed
seedID <- 3
set.seed(seedID)
p <- 10
NOPS <- 2# Number of pairs of swaps 
r <- 8
q <- 5
alpha <- log(9 / 4)
beta <- log(4)
quantile <- 0.35
Eigen <- 3 # Build correlation by extracting factor loading from the real data set
fam_type <- 'binomial'
Absence <- 'TRUE'
FactorLoading <- Lambda

# Subsample from the original pool containing 115 species
Subsample <- sample(TruePara, p)

# Build up the subtree and calculate its distance matrix
subtree <- keep.tip(tree, names(Subsample))
DM <- cophenetic.phylo(subtree)
S <- max(DM) - DM
J <- diag(1, p) - (1/p) * matrix(1, p, p)
S_J <- J %*% S %*% J

# The number of main axes important in signalling diversity changes
val_num.eig <- get_num.eig(Methods = 'Method3', 
                           Methods_para = NA,
                           D = diag(eigen(S_J)$values)[-p, -p])
```

# 2 Data Generation
```{r cars}
data <- getData(DM_phy_func = DM, q = q, alpha = alpha, beta = beta,
                r = r, quantile = quantile, Eigen = Eigen,
                Distribution = fam_type, p = p,
                     Absence = TRUE, Subsample = Subsample,
                FactorLoading = FactorLoading, NOS = NOPS)

data$yX %>%
  dplyr::group_by(com) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    presences = sum(y),
    prevalence = mean(y),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

xtabs(y ~ com + sp, data = data$yX)
```

# 3 Modelling
```{r}
Model <- fit_model(type = 'p_mid', matrix_type = 'P_J', rr = TRUE, LV_num = 2,
                      yX = data$yX, P_J = eigen(S_J)$vectors, 
                      val_num.eig = val_num.eig, Distribution = fam_type, 
                      null = FALSE, p = p, site = FALSE)
```


# 4 Model fixing 
## 4.1 by changing a different optimizer (the first try)
```{r}
K_names <- paste0("p", (val_num.eig + 1):p)
K <- diag(length(K_names))
dimnames(K) <- list(K_names, K_names)

# Try optimizer optim
Model_optim <- update(Model$fit,
                      family = stats::binomial(link = "logit"),
                      data = Model$fit$frame,
                              control=glmmTMBControl(optimizer=optim,
                                                     optArgs=list(method="BFGS")))
# Comparison
## Compare parameters
p1 <- Model$fit$fit$par
p2 <- Model_optim$fit$par

stopifnot(identical(names(p1), names(p2)))

parameter_comparison <- data.frame(
  component = names(p1),
  index = ave(seq_along(p1), names(p1), FUN = seq_along),
  nlminb = unname(p1),
  optim = unname(p2),
  difference = unname(p2 - p1)
)


## Compare model convergence
ModelComparison_optimizer<- data.frame(
  fit = c("nlminb", "optim"),
  objective = c(
    Model$fit$fit$objective,
    Model_optim$fit$objective
  ),
  convergence = c(
    Model$convergence,
    Model_optim$fit$convergence
  ),
  pdHess = c(
    Model$pdHess,
    Model_optim$sdr$pdHess
  )
)
print(ModelComparison_optimizer)
```
### 4.1.1 Check what is the conveyed starting values to Model_optim
```{r}
start <- Model_optim$obj$par
final <- Model_optim$fit$par

data.frame(
  component = names(start),
  start = unname(start),
  final = unname(final)
)

print(all.equal(Model$fit$obj$par, Model_optim$obj$par))
print(Model$fit$obj$par)
#print(Model_optim$obj$par)

print(all.equal(Model_optim$obj$env$parameters$b, 
          Model$fit$obj$env$parameters$b))
#print(Model_optim$obj$env$parameters$b)
print(Model$fit$obj$env$parameters$b)
```
The outputs say that the starting values conveyed into Model_optim aren't changed even though we get Model_optim from updating Model$fit. 

## 4.2 Model fixing by changing starting values as Model_optim's estimates (the first try)
```{r}
# Try a different starting value
start_opt <- Model_optim$obj$env$parList(
  Model_optim$fit$par,
  Model_optim$fit$parfull
)

start_opt <- start_opt[lengths(start_opt) > 0]

fit_formula <- formula(Model_optim)
environment(fit_formula) <- environment()  # makes the current K available

Model_restart <- update(
  Model_optim,
  formula = fit_formula,
  data = Model_optim$frame,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  start = start_opt
)

p3 <- Model_optim$fit$par
p4 <- Model_restart$fit$par

stopifnot(identical(names(p3), names(p4)))

# Comparison
## Compare parameters
parameter_comparison_restart <- data.frame(
  component = names(p3),
  index = ave(seq_along(p3), names(p3), FUN = seq_along),
  optim = unname(p1),
  BFGS = unname(p3),
  BFGS_restart = unname(p4)
)

## Compare model convergence
ModelComparison_restart <- data.frame(
  fit = c("BFGS", "BFGS restart"),
  objective = c(
    Model_optim$fit$objective,
    Model_restart$fit$objective
  ),
  convergence = c(
    Model_optim$fit$convergence,
    Model_restart$fit$convergence
  ),
  pdHess = c(
    Model_optim$sdr$pdHess,
    Model_restart$sdr$pdHess
  )
)

print(ModelComparison_restart)
```
## 4.3 By using reduced-rank starting-value settings (the second try)
```{r}
seeds <- c(101 : 120)

runs <- lapply(seeds, function(seed) {
  warnings <- character()

  fit <- tryCatch(
    withCallingHandlers(
      refit(seed),
      warning = function(w) {
        warnings <<- c(warnings, conditionMessage(w))
        tryInvokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )

  failed <- inherits(fit, "error")

  list(
    fit = if (failed) NULL else fit,
    warnings = warnings,
    error = if (failed) conditionMessage(fit) else NA_character_
  )
})

fits <- lapply(runs, `[[`, "fit")

results <- data.frame(
  seed = seeds,
  objective = vapply(fits, function(m)
    if (is.null(m)) NA_real_ else m$fit$objective, numeric(1)),
  convergence = vapply(fits, function(m)
    if (is.null(m)) NA_integer_ else as.integer(m$fit$convergence), integer(1)),
  pdHess = vapply(fits, function(m)
    if (is.null(m)) NA else m$sdr$pdHess, logical(1)),
  warnings = vapply(runs, function(x)
    if (length(x$warnings)) paste(x$warnings, collapse = " | ")
    else NA_character_, character(1)),
  error = vapply(runs, function(x) x$error, character(1))
)
results <- dplyr::arrange(results, objective)
print(results)
```

### 4.3.1 Model Diagnosis
```{r}
Model_res_101 <- fits[[1]]

# Model diagnosis
# res<- simulateResiduals(
#   fittedModel = Model_res_101,   #Your glmmTMB object
#   n = 1000              # Normally in 500–1000
# )

## Residual plot: dunn-smyth vs predicted values
fitted_values <- fitted(Model_res_101)
dunn_smyth_residuals <- residuals(Model_res_101, type = "dunn-smyth")

plot(
  fitted_values,
  dunn_smyth_residuals,
  pch = 16,
  col = adjustcolor("black", alpha.f = 0.35),
  xlab = "Fitted values",
  ylab = " Dunn-Smyth residuals"
)

abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)

lines(
  lowess(fitted_values, dunn_smyth_residuals),
  col = "blue",
  lwd = 2
)
```
